timing_observation.description: RTT values show a structured drift through much of the run: after the first sample, successful RTT generally rises from about 181.598 ms toward 182.049 ms through sequence 18, then sequences 19-20 return to about 181.067-181.104 ms.
timing_observation.status: candidate instrumentation/radio timing phenomenon; no causal attribution
